fact: The Case Tracking System was running in seven regions (Greater Accra, Ashanti, Northern, Volta, Bono, Western and Eastern) and over 40 districts, with 55 police stations and 3 prisons using it among 757 user centres, and 2,475 cases registered since December 2021; inconsistent use, poor internet access, officers' IT skills and transfers of trained officers were named as hindrances.
title: Let's Resource Case Tracking System - LRC
